result: NOVA proteins regulate the inclusion of cryptic exons in messenger RNA specifically in nerve cells, thereby influencing the abundance of the corresponding proteins. This regulatory mechanism depends on the capacity of cryptic exons to be included in mRNA transcripts.
status_reasoning: All claims (C1-C4) are based solely on inference without experimental data, statistical analysis, or citations provided in this manuscript excerpt. The abstract presents these as findings, but the excerpt lacks the methodological details, controls, sample sizes, or empirical evidence necessary to evaluate whether the claims are supported by rigorous experimentation. This appears to be a commentary or perspective piece rather than a primary research article, making it impossible to assess the underlying evidence.
